cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.

mechanism: A coaches its baking pupil to treat a collapsed cake, broken oven and overnight deadline as ingredients of a more spectacular victory.
confusable: Not merely solving equipment trouble: each worsening fact explicitly increases the glory A expects from winning.
comparison: Recruiting dispersed team versus urgent replacement appliance.
